description:
Accept a namespace invitation addressed to THIS authenticated account's verified email (two-step email OTP).

Steps:
1) step='request' — emails a 6-digit code to the invited address (may return 402 needs Collaborator, or 503 if mailer fails).
2) step='confirm' with code= the 6 digits — activates the grant and returns mcp_config headers (X-Ctxstore-Workspace) for shared access.

The code activates the named grant_id only; it authorizes nothing else. Obtain grant_id from list_invites(). Docs: https://ctxstore.ai/docs.html#verify-invitations

grant_id.description: UUID of the invitation (from list_invites or invite email).

step.description: request = send OTP email; confirm = submit code.

name: accept_invite
title: Accept Namespace Invitation
